question: What is the canonical threat actor name, resolving any aliases mentioned across these reports?
answer:
- Canonical Threat Actor Name: Karakurt
- Aliases: Karakurt Team, Karakurt Lair
- First Observed: June 2021
- Motivation: Financially driven pure data-extortion (no ransomware encryption)
- Initial Access: Stolen or brokered VPN credentials (often single-factor FortiGate VPNs, unpatched devices), phishing
- Privilege Escalation: Attempted CVE-2020-1472 (Zerologon), achieved domain-admin via PsExec and RDP
- Persistence: Service creation, deployment of AnyDesk, Cobalt Strike C2 beacons
- Credential Harvesting: Mimikatz, PowerShell dumps of ntds.dit, Volume Shadow Copy extraction of NTDS.dit
- Lateral Movement: PsExec and RDP to primary domain controller
- Data Exfiltration: Compression with WinZip/7zip; use of Rclone, SFTP, FileZilla to Mega.io and other cloud hosts
- Notable Artefacts: 11.6 BTC moved into Conti wallets, shared file-tree.txt, DNS zone export generating Event ID 3150
